description: When anchor registers Oxford comma at >=95% consistency, a reading with Oxford comma earns +0.75; one without earns 0

triggering.notes: anchor_style has oxford_comma=True (sampled at >=95% consistency); reading contains ', and' pattern -> modifier fires at +0.75; competitor lacks the serial comma -> no modifier

near_miss.near_miss_reason: anchor_style is empty dict (anchor consistency was 80%, below the 95% threshold required by ADR-0013 R25 to register a convention); convention not registered -> modifier does not fire even though reading has Oxford comma
